title: Crochet Peacock Feather (Morpankh)
name: Peacock Feather
description: Free crochet peacock feather (morpankh) pattern: a dark blue eye, light blue, yellow and green rounds and a picot edge. Printable PDF, round by round.
lead: A colourful morpankh worked from the eye outwards. Each round grows more at the tip, which gives the feather its pointed shape, and a dark green picot round finishes it.
yarn: Cotton yarn in dark blue, light blue, yellow, light green and dark green

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn in dark blue, light blue, yellow, light green and dark green

notes: The 8th stitch of round 2 is the tip of the feather. Every later round puts its extra stitches at this tip.

rounds.text: Dark blue: magic ring, ch 2, 15 dc in the ring, sl st.
Light blue: (sc, inc) x3, sc, 3 sc in the 8th st, (sc, inc) x3, sc, sl st.
Yellow: (sc, inc) x2, (hdc, inc) x2, (dc, inc), tr, 3 tr in the same st (tip), tr, (inc, dc), (inc, hdc) x2, (inc, sc) x2, sl st.
Light green: sc in the next 17 sts, 3 sc in the 18th st, sc in the next 17 sts, sl st.
Dark green: 3 hdc, ch 3 picot, (2 dc, ch 3 picot) until you have 8 picots, 1 dc, (2 dc, ch 4 picot, 2 dc) in the tip, 1 dc, picot, (2 dc, ch 3 picot) until you have 8 more picots, 3 hdc. Fasten off.

finishing: Weave in the ends on the back.
